title: Mapping keys that are strings but look like other types
refs: YAML 1.1 types (yaml.org/type): bool, int, float, timestamp, merge, value
notes: A key is resolved like any other scalar, so the same quoting rules apply to it. Keys that are strings but read as booleans, numbers or null when plain are quoted, and the empty key is written as an empty quoted scalar. This is a writing convention of the family, not the specification: a string is written plain only when every common reader reads it as that same string, so the text is judged under the YAML 1.2 Core schema (loose) and also under YAML 1.1 and the number forms common readers accept (strict).
